name: glm-tp2-vision
_comment: Portable configuration example: host, user and private workspace paths are placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Historical context follows; this is not a new qualification claim. GLM-5.3-Flash 2.25bpw with IMAGES as a two-rank tensor-parallel group (lane L13, docs/GLM_TP.md section 10): N4 = rank 0 (serves HTTP, holds the vision tower, encodes every image and sends the rows of each prefill chunk), N1 = rank 1 (no tower: the server gives a follower no vision slot whatever its flags, and the Hello's leader-only vision fact refuses a follower that holds one). Each rank maps and allocates only its share of the routed experts (46.3 GiB). No --no-vision in serve.flags (rank 0 must serve images; the schema cannot give a follower a vision flag rank 0 does not have, and the follower needs none). --prefix-cache off, --spec none (the serial legs; tools/glm_tp_vision_two_node.sh derives the --spec mtp|auto legs, lane L14), pinned --slots and --kv-tokens. The rank planner (tp_boot tests, 117 GiB free): rank 0 46.32 GiB of weights + the tower 2.09 GiB (weights 1.05, scratch at 8,000 tokens 1.04) + a features reserve of 1.95 GiB (4 slots); rank 1 46.32 GiB. N2 and N3 are the gn100s: disabled by owner rule, listed so that a rank map naming them is refused.
